title: Northstar rehearsal milestone logic
state: unconstrained offset model with resource scenario

tasks.label: Validate mapping
tasks.exit_evidence: Mapping exceptions are resolved or bounded
tasks.note: One of two tied controlling branches.

tasks.exit_evidence: Restore environment is reachable and verified

tasks.exit_evidence: Population reconciles and restore is demonstrated

scenarios.label: Chen performs B before C
scenarios.change: Add B-before-C as an explicit resource-ordering link.

scenarios.effect: Adds three offsets versus the technical network.

scenarios.label: Accelerate mapping only

scenarios.effect: No finish improvement while C remains controlling.

presentation.headline: Two branches govern the same milestone
presentation.lede: Accelerating mapping alone does not move acceptance, and shared-specialist work needs an explicit feasible sequence.
presentation.decision: Confirm Chen's capacity, environment access and Saira's review window before translating the model to the cutover calendar.

analysis.method: Forward/backward pass for acyclic finish-to-start zero-lag logic.
analysis.model_limit: No calendar, fixed constraints, lag, other relationship types or resource leveling.
analysis.resource_boundary: The seven-offset base model assumes B and C can run with separate capacity; the ten-offset scenario makes Chen's shared assignment explicit.
